content: # UNITED STATES SECURITIES AND EXCHANGE COMMISSION ## Washington, D.C. 20549 ## FORM 10-K: APPLE INC. ### Annual Report for the Fiscal Year Ended September 28, 2024 ---

pple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets smartphones, personal computers, tablets, wearables, and accessories, and sells a variety of related services. Founded in 1977, the Company offers products including iPhone, Mac, iPad, Apple Watch, AirPods, and Apple Vision Pro. ### Ecosystem & Services The Company's business strategy leverages its unique ability to design and develop its own operating systems (iOS, macOS, watchOS, iPadOS, visionOS), hardware, application software, and services to provide its customers products and solutions with innovative design, superior ease-of-use, and seamless integration. Services include the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, AppleCare, Apple TV+, and iCloud storage subscriptions. ---

### Regulatory and Antitrust Scrutiny on the App Store The Company faces intense legal and regulatory scrutiny across the United States, European Union, and other international jurisdictions regarding its App Store guidelines, digital commissions, and developer terms. In March 2024, the U.S. Department of Justice (DOJ), along with 16 state attorneys general, filed a civil antitrust lawsuit alleging Apple illegally monopolizes smartphone markets under Section 2 of the Sherman Act. Additionally, compliance with the European Union's Digital Markets Act (DMA) requires Apple to permit alternative app marketplaces and payment processors, which may reduce Services gross margin and commission retention. ### Global Supply Chain and Geopolitical Exposure A substantial portion of the Company's manufacturing, final assembly, and component sourcing is performed by outsourced partners located in China, India, and

icrosoft Corporation is a technology company whose mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. We develop and support software, services, devices, and solutions that deliver new value for customers and help our clients realize their full potential in an era of intelligent cloud and artificial intelligence. ### Operating Segments We operate our business across three core segments: 1. **Productivity and Business Processes:** Includes Office Commercial (Microsoft 365 subscriptions), Office Consumer, LinkedIn, and Dynamics business solutions (ERP and CRM). 2. **Intelligent Cloud:** Consists of our public, private, and hybrid server products and cloud services, most notably Microsoft Azure, Windows Server, SQL Server, Visual Studio, and Enterprise Services. 3. **More Personal Computing:** Includes Windows OEM licensing, Surface devices, Xbox gaming hardware and

### Cloud Infrastructure & AI Capacity Constraints Our business model increasingly relies on massive, hyperscale cloud data centers to support customer migrations to Azure and the rapid deployment of generative AI services (including Copilot and Azure OpenAI Service). If our supply chain partners experience delays delivering custom AI accelerators, electrical power infrastructure, or specialized server racks, we may face capacity constraints that prevent us from fulfilling customer demand, resulting in lost market share and delayed revenue recognition. ### OpenAI Partnership & Technological Dependencies We maintain significant commercial partnerships and equity investments in OpenAI. We license OpenAI proprietary foundation models to power Microsoft Copilot across our commercial ecosystem. pioneered accelerated computing to tackle challenges ordinary computers cannot. Since our founding in 1993, we have specialized in visual computing and accelerated computing architectures. We invented the Graphics Processing Unit (GPU) in 1999, which defined modern computer graphics, sparked PC gaming, and ignited the modern era of Artificial Intelligence (AI). ### Platform Architecture & Operating Segments Our operations are organized into two primary reportable segments: 1. **Compute & Networking:** Includes our Data Center accelerated computing platforms, quantum computing architectures, networking infrastructure (Quantum InfiniBand, Spectrum Ethernet, BlueField DPUs), AI Enterprise software, and automotive autonomous driving platforms (NVIDIA DRIVE). 2. **Graphics:** Includes GeForce GPUs for gaming and PCs, GeForce NOW cloud gaming, Quadro/NVIDIA RTX GPUs for enterprise workstation graphics, and virtual GPU software for cloud-based visual computing. ### Manufacturing &

We partner with world-class independent semiconductor foundries, primarily Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (TSMC), for wafer manufacturing, as well as specialized subcontractors in Asia for packaging, assembly, and testing. ---

### Supply Chain & Manufacturing Concentration We rely on third-party foundries, primarily TSMC, to manufacture all of our semiconductor wafers. We do not own or operate wafer fabrication facilities. If TSMC experiences disruptions due to natural disasters, geopolitical tensions in Taiwan, equipment failures, or capacity constraints, our ability to supply accelerated computing products would be severely impaired. ### Export Controls and Geopolitics In October 2023, the U.S. Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS) updated export regulations concerning advanced computing chips and semiconductor manufacturing equipment destined for China and other restricted jurisdictions. These regulations expanded licensing requirements for products exceeding specific performance thresholds (including our A100, H100, A800, and H800 architectures).
